strategy_exits.long_term_growth: Review fundamentals, valuation and thesis; approximately half-yearly; no automatic ATR exit.
strategy_exits.triple_screen: Initial and monotonic trailing stop: 2 x fixed entry ATR.
strategy_exits.bb_revert: Fixed 3 x entry ATR; close >= current SMA20 exits next regular open; entry day count 0, 15 subsequent sessions then next-open exit.
strategy_exits.mom_12_1: Month-end ranking, next-open rebalance; SPY/SMA200 filter; no ATR stop.

atr_method: Project TR.ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False); differs from strict Wilder initialization.
